details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept beacon that fires at install time. Its postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") sends an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package, over a self-signed certificate (TLS verification disabled). The payload is limited to install detection metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the package __dirname install path, the process working directory, the npm/node version string and the URL protocol. No environment variables, files, credentials, tokens or other host data are read or transmitted, and the package contains no other executable logic. The scoped name @c1-ease/bank targets an internal-package namespace, and the README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test.
